program_amendments.change: Replace overhead cable triceps extensions with cable pushdowns, starting at 50 lb, due to athlete-reported tendon stress. Ongoing replacement; no automatic overhead restoration.
Hold direct biceps loads/reps/set counts at latest performed doses until elbow symptoms resolve/review. Defer unintroduced reverse curls; keep wrist-curl review separate.

Adopt pace-first running: one recovered session with all-rep pace headroom can earn 5–15 s/mi; comfortable effort earns 5, otherwise two comparable hits earn 5. Hold minutes on pace changes. Remove calendar speed locks; only relevant recovery/tolerance restrictions limit running.

Release temporary biceps maintenance after symptom resolution and symptom-free working curls. Resume normal achieved-stage sets/ranges at current loads; allow ordinary conditional forearm introduction without granting new exposure or W6 eligibility.

Assume normal general recovery unless an exception is reported; after logging automatically generate and publish the next scheduled workout. Preserve actual observations, injury restrictions and date-correct previews.

Replace only standard cable curls with unilateral machine preacher curls in future Thursday Upper B sessions. Starting reference75lb,8–12perarm, existing stage set count and2minrest. TodayNovember5 remains exactly as issued; hammer, reverse, wrist and incline curls are unchanged.
